system.description: You plant your destrier across the road like a gate. Sustained: neither of you can move, be pushed or be knocked Prone, and allies adjacent to your destrier have light cover. Using the power needs no test. Instead, when a foe enters your reach, you may use your reaction (↻) to make a melee attack against it: that attack is the power's test (DR16), and it deals d12 instead of your weapon damage.

outcomes.ruin: No damage, and the foe slips past your guard: the power ends.
